parsed.name: USBtin USB-CAN 适配器
parsed.description: USBtin 是一种通过串口命令控制的 USB 转 CAN 总线适配器，用于让计算机连接、监听和发送 CAN 报文。该设备支持设置 CAN 波特率与工作模式（如主动、只听、回环），并可配置 MCP2515 的寄存器、过滤器和掩码，适用于实验室中的 CAN 设备联机、总线监测、协议调试与嵌入式系统测试。
parsed.description_en: USBtin is a USB-to-CAN bus adapter controlled through serial commands, used to let a computer connect to, monitor, and transmit CAN frames. It supports CAN baud rate and mode configuration (such as active, listen-only, and loopback), and can configure MCP2515 registers, filters, and masks for laboratory CAN device interfacing, bus monitoring, protocol debugging, and embedded-system testing.
